name: open-router
label: OpenRouter
description: Use any AI model to generate code, text, or images via OpenRouter.ai.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
1. Open [openrouter.ai/keys](https://openrouter.ai/keys) and sign in.
2. Click **Create Key**, name it and copy the key.
3. Paste it here. It starts with `sk-or-`.

list_models.label: List Models
list_models.description: Lists the models available through OpenRouter, with pricing and context limits.

category.label: Category
category.description: Only return models tagged for this use case.

list_embedding_models.label: List Embedding Models
list_embedding_models.description: Lists the embedding models available through OpenRouter.

list_user_models.label: List My Available Models
list_user_models.description: Lists the models your account can actually use once your provider preferences, privacy settings, and guardrails are applied.

list_model_endpoints.label: List Providers for a Model
list_model_endpoints.description: Lists every provider serving a specific model, with the pricing and uptime each one offers.

model.label: Model
model.description: The model to list providers for.

list_providers.label: List Providers
list_providers.description: Lists the upstream AI model providers routed through OpenRouter.

get_credits.label: Get Credits
get_credits.description: Gets this account's current API credit balance and total usage.

get_current_key.label: Get API Key Usage
get_current_key.description: Gets usage, spend limit, and rate-limit info for your connected API key.
